title: Gravitational torque drives multidecadal variations in length of day
title_zh: 引力驱动地球自转多年期变化
abstract: Fluctuations in the length of day (LOD) on decadal timescales are caused primarily by an exchange of angular momentum between the Earth’s mantle and core1–3. Several mechanisms have been proposed to explain this exchange, including electromagnetic4–7 and topographic8–10 coupling at the core–mantle boundary (CMB) and a gravitational torque by the inner core11,12. However, the precise nature of the core–mantle torque remains unknown. Here we show that the seismically reconstructed differential rotation of the inner core13–15 and core flows derived from magnetic field changes16,17 suggest that the multidecadal LOD changes are driven primarily by the gravitational torque and resisted by electromagnetic and topographic torques, consistent with results from Earth-like dynamo models18. Our reconstructed torque histories, although tied to the accuracy of the inner core rotation and core flow models, support a lowermost mantle that features near-neutrally buoyant thermochemical piles19–21, a post-perovskite (pPv) phase with a low viscosity22 and a highly conducting23,24 iron-enriched layer a few kilometres thick at its base25. Our results also suggest a low-viscosity inner core deforming in only a few years26–28 and yield an upper limit on the stratification at the top of the fluid core. Altogether, our study contributes to bringing into focus an emerging picture of the deepest regions of our planet. Multidecadal fluctuations in Earth’s length of day are shown to be driven by gravitational torque and resisted by electromagnetic and topographic forces, improving our understanding of the material properties and dynamics of Earth’s deep interior.
abstract_zh: 地球自转长度（LOD）在十年尺度上的波动主要由地幔和核心之间的角动量交换引起1–3。已有多种机制被提出以解释这种交换，包括在核幔界面（CMB）的电磁4–7和地形8–10耦合，以及内核的引力扭矩11,12。然而，核幔扭矩的精确性质仍然未知。在此，我们展示了内核的径向自转13–15的地震重建以及由磁场变化推导的核心流动16,17表明，多年期LOD的变化主要由引力扭矩驱动，并受电磁和地形扭矩阻碍，这与地球类动力学模型18的结果一致。我们重建的扭矩历史虽然依赖于内核自转和核心流动模型的准确性，但支持一个低ermost mantle，其特征为近中性浮力热化学堆积体19–21，后裂变钙钛矿（pPv）相具有低粘度22，以及其基部几公里厚的高导电铁富集层25。我们的研究还表明，内核低粘度，仅在几年内发生变形26–28，并对流体核顶部的分层给出了上限。总之，我们的研究有助于聚焦地球最深层区域的新兴图景。多年期地球自转长度的波动被证明是由引力扭矩驱动，并受电磁和地形力阻碍，提高了我们对地球深部物质性质和动力学的理解。
